authorizedRoute.safeHumanAction: Send only a concise asset-free inquiry asking for URY’s current airplay or music-submission procedure. Do not attach audio or include private track links until the Music Team confirms an authorized delivery method.

businessContact.emailStatus: verified first-party Music Team contact published in plaintext on University Radio York’s official Contact page
businessContact.verification: The official Contact page publishes music@ury.org.uk under Music Team and explicitly invites musicians and up-and-coming bands seeking airtime to contact the team. The address has valid syntax, uses the official ury.org.uk domain and has a clear music and airplay purpose. It is not classified as authorization to send audio assets because no delivery specification is published. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.

activityVerification.evidence: URY’s official homepage lists Open Days broadcasts on June 20-21, 2026 and podcasts through June 30, 2026. Its About page states that it broadcasts 24 hours a day during term time on FM and digital radio in York and worldwide online.

genreFitEvidence: URY describes its output as a mixture of different genres and tailor-made shows.
The official Music Team description covers specialist genre shows, music journalism, live sessions by local and touring musicians and a large vinyl collection.

Selected clean MarcsMusic electronic, bass, reggae-adjacent, world-fusion and crossover releases have plausible specialist-show or airplay fit, subject to URY’s unpublished current eligibility and delivery requirements.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: University Radio York’s official Contact page publishes music@ury.org.uk for its Music Team and explicitly invites musicians or up-and-coming bands seeking airtime to contact the team. The page does not publish attachment-versus-link rules, accepted formats, file-size limits, metadata or EPK requirements, release windows, international eligibility, clean or explicit-content rules, AI-origin policy, response times or physical-delivery instructions. A human must re-open the current page, send only a concise asset-free process inquiry, wait for explicit delivery instructions, permission-check the selected release and avoid parallel outreach to management, programme, newsroom, production or general contacts.

deduplication.repositoryEvidence: The complete open pull-request patch was searched for University Radio York, the URY name, the canonical domain and the purpose-specific Music Team mailbox. No previous music-submission-agent platform or queue record was found.
deduplication.consolidation: The purpose-bound Music Team mailbox is stored as one inquiry route. Management, Programme Controller, Newsroom, Production Team, general office and postal contacts are excluded as parallel submission methods.

notes: One new free-first Music Team airplay-process inquiry route was queued as needs_manual_review. No audio-delivery or physical-delivery method was inferred and no outbound action was taken.
